description: Cyd's private head, and nothing about it apologizes for the plumbing. Black marble underfoot, a wall of smoked glass, gold fixtures that were never going to be anything but gold. A rain-head shower stands behind a single sheet of glass; the low sink and the toilet are tucked discreetly to one side. The same floral-and-money scent as the suite hangs here, softened by steam. A brushed bolt on the hatch slides shut when Cyd wants the world to wait.
name: Echelon — Owner's Head
